item.title: Studies of Auditing "On-the-Ground" in the Majority World
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites submissions that provide on-the-ground empirical studies of auditing practices, processes, and institutions in the Majority World countries. We welcome research that examines auditing as it is actually practiced in real-world contexts, moving beyond theoretical frameworks to understand the lived experiences of auditors, audit clients, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Timeline

  • December 31, 2027: Full paper submission deadline

item.title: Grounded in Causality: Elevating Evidence for Leadership Practice
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of The Leadership Quarterly seeks empirical research that advances our understanding of leadership through rigorous causal inference methods. We invite submissions that employ experimental designs, quasi-experimental approaches, longitudinal studies, or other methodologically sound approaches to establish causal relationships in leadership phenomena.

Timeline

  • November 22, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
